  \[ a(a^2 + b^2) + b(b^2 + c^2) + c(c^2 + a^2) \geq 6 \]
  To prove this, we use the non-negativity of squares. Specifically, we consider the squares of the differences \(a - b\), \(b - c\), and \(c - a\). Since these squares are non-negative, we can derive the desired inequality by summing these expressions and simplifying.

  -- Specifically, consider the squares of (a - b), (b - c), and (c - a).
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - c), sq_nonneg (c - a),
    sq_nonneg (a - 1), sq_nonneg (b - 1), sq_nonneg (c - 1)]
